verdicts.reason: Both candidates fail the same way. The whole background artwork (green, blue and red triangles, the decorative lines and the wind-turbine icon) has been shrunk into a tiny strip to the left of the headline. The turbine, the design's key image, ends up as an unreadable speck, the bold headline crowds the right edge, and the top half and bottom third are mostly empty. A is very slightly better because its two leftover lines sit together as a pair at the bottom. In B the upper line nearly touches 'MARCH 18' and there is a large awkward gap between the two lines.
